initial:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: production 2D rear-facing game sprite correction, twelve poses in a 4 COLUMN x 3 ROW sheet, transparent RGBA.
Input 1 (four rear idle/archery figures) and Input 2 (eight walking figures) are edit targets defining EXACT outfit, view, poses, bow placement, gait and feet. Input 3 is the same character FRONT VIEW, used ONLY for HEAD AND TORSO PROPORTIONS AND BODY MASS. Do not draw any front face in output.
Fix a measured art error: rear head and upper torso are 40 percent too small. Redraw a consistent MUCH LARGER head-and-upper-body above the black belt, preserving normal original lower-body dimensions and leg poses. NOT an overall scale-up. All twelve must depict the EXACT same child hero as inputs: compact black high bun with red tie; richly quilted cream robe, black belt, scalloped cream skirt panels, voluminous dark-blue knee pants, cream wrapped calves, black cloth shoes with tan sewn soles; gold carved recurved bow and red bindings; red textured scarf trailing viewer RIGHT. Elevated rear 3/4 top-down camera like inputs. Hair silhouette compact yet larger, consistent skull/bun scale with front reference. Round child head must dominate upper body similarly to front. Strong shoulders, readable sleeves and back of robe. No face or eyes.
MANDATORY GEOMETRY for every equal 384x512 portrait cell in a 1536x1536 image: head crown around y=35; lower EDGE of black waist belt around y=320; shared virtual foot-ground origin around (192,475). Thus crown-to-belt about285 pixels, belt-to-ground about155 pixels. This is about65% upper /35% lower of standing body. Head hair silhouette width about155px, shoulders about210px. Waist remains attached naturally to existing short pants, NO long neck, no tall adult body, no thin stretched torso. Enlarge and redraw the head AND shoulder/torso mass naturally, keep short child legs. All poses same proportions and camera, head crown and waist at similar heights.
POSE ORDER: row1 is FOUR full-body rear archery phases matching Input1 left to right: relaxed idle bow held LOW viewer-left; draw bow horizontally at shoulder level with arrow aimed away/up image; release; recover with low bow. ROW2 = first four walking poses from Input2. ROW3 = last four walking poses from Input2. Walk poses: alternating legs lifted, passed, planted, readable raised soles, maintain same eight phase leg identities, feet separation, no duplicated half-cycle. Upper body idle-like with low bow viewer-left throughout walk. Keep one gold bow per sprite, correct grip and bowstring. No floating weapons.
All sprites complete and separated with 15px minimum transparent cell margin, no clipping, no neighbor overlap. Extra care on fine hair strands, consistent ink contour weight, layered Chinese shadow-puppet craft / textured illustration finish, embroidered red fabric, crinkled parchment cream cloth, gold filigree and wrapped shins. Do not blur or simplify. Crisp real transparent alpha, no checkerboard, no scenery, no ground, no shadows, no labels, no grid or text. This is proportion calibration of existing identity, not a new costume or new character.
